# nemau_floating_ip (Resource)

A public address allocated to the project.

Allocation and association are separate resources, as in the API (see `nemau_floating_ip_association`). This lets you keep the address while replacing the machine behind it.

An IPv6 floating IP (`ip_version = 6`) is translated to the target's private IPv4 address on the region's exit node: the guest needs no IPv6 configuration and sees IPv6 clients as addresses of the translation range. A target holds at most one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_floating_ip" "web" {
  description = "Public address of the web instance"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description. Changes in place.
- `external_network_id` (String) Id of the external network to allocate from. When omitted, the region's external network is used. Changing it replaces the floating IP.
- `ip_version` (Number) `4` (the default) or `6`.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The allocated IP address.
- `id` (String) Floating IP id.
- `status` (String) Status as reported by the platform.

## Import

```shell
# A floating IP imports by its id.
terraform import nemau_floating_ip.web 4e8c2a7d-6f1b-4d39-8b05-3a9e7c1f2d64
```
